en: A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a panoramic view of a town with timber-framed buildings and tiled rooftops nestled in a valley. In the background, atop a wooded hill, stands a prominent castle-like structure. The text on the card, printed in an old German typeface, reads 'Nöschenrode a. Harz. Blick von der Liebfrauenkirche.' There is also vertical text along the right edge with publisher information.
